ops.body:
General pack 0.26.0 / repo 9.29.0 (commit ae212caf, 2026-07-18): on macOS with a resolvable `trash` binary, the rm guard rewrites recoverably-risky deletes to `<trash path> <targets>` instead of denying — but ONLY for literal outside-repo targets and globs whose ≤`GLOB_LIMIT` matches were each individually verified.

**Globs matching >10 files and too-broad globs deny on every platform — this is a deliberate post-review narrowing, not a regression.** Adversarial verification confirmed by execution that rewriting them trashes a repo root hiding beyond the `limit+1` collection prefix (`rm -rf *` in a directory with >11 entries, repo at position 12+), violating the user-decided repo-root-always-blocks invariant. Do not "restore" the oversized-glob rewrite without solving exhaustive match verification.

Emission soundness rests on provenance gates in `emit_token` (was `emit_target`) / the rm walk: `plain_words` (no quote chars in `Command.raw`) gates verbatim emission of glob/tilde tokens; brace tokens and non-provenanced backslash tokens forfeit the rewrite; a `\`-newline continuation anywhere in the occurrence forfeits it (cc-transcript splits `foo\⏎bar` into two args where the shell joins to `foobar`); the trash path is shlex-quoted. All confirmed against cc_transcript's parser by execution.

---

## Wave 2 — general pack 0.27.0 / repo 10.2.0 (commit 0c91b39e, 2026-07-18)

The wave-1 rewrite regressed two hard denies (`rm -rf /`, `rm -rf ~/Code` trashed instead of denying — blocker note c24ac338). Wave 2 closes them and cleans up the code:

- **`blast_radius_block`** adds three hard-deny tiers on the rewrite path — filesystem root, home dirs (`Path.home()`/`/Users`/`/Users/<x>`), and any dir that `contains_repo` (bounded fail-closed 20k scan). Gated on `rewritable`; `os.path.normpath`-normalized so a trailing `..` can't dodge equality; tier order equality-before-scan.
- **Nested-shell descent** (`descend_rm`, check-only, depth-capped, combined `-…c` clusters) closes the `bash -c 'rm -rf /'` bypass.
- **cwd-threading** made faithful: a failed (`cd /missing`) or piped `cd` no longer moves the effective cwd.
- **Rebuilt on the new `rewrite_command_occurrences(visit=...)` primitive** (WalkContext/Rewritten); VCS predicates + provenance emission extracted to `util/vcs.py` + `util/shell.py`, shared with the fixes classifier.

Reviewed by codex sol finder + Claude opus refuter; deferred adversarial/upstream gaps (subshell-`cd`, wrapper option-arity, APFS case aliases) are backlogged. Threat model: doc 54548bc9. **Adversarial-framed codex review prompts trip OpenAI's cyber content filter — the refuter runs on the Claude opus lane; the clinically-framed finder runs fine on codex.**

Tag `v10.2.0` NOT cut — push/tag is user-gated (the release trigger). Commit `0c91b39e` is on origin/main; `v10.1.0` was consumed by a concurrent performance-pack release (this checkout's HEAD was the v10.1.0 tag), hence the jump to 10.2.0 ([[capt-hook-release-rollout-gotchas]], [[concurrent-release-race-protocol]]).
